ir.name: loss_diff_advantage_clamp_mean
ir.intuition: This crossover combines the stable advantage-based approach from the parent favoring 'pairwise_diff' paradigm with the bounding and smoothness properties of the clamp on the log probability difference. It leverages a constrained difference in log probabilities weighted by advantage gap, promoting preference alignment while maintaining numerical stability and smooth gradients. This fused approach integrates the benefits of advantage weighting with a stable clamping mechanism, enhancing the robustness and interpretability of the loss.
ir.pseudocode:
adv = batch['advantage_gap']
margin = ops.mul(ops.clamp(ops.sub(batch['log_prob_w'], batch['log_prob_l']), 0.0, 1e9), adv)
loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.ones_like(adv), margin))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']

    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_clamped = ops.clamp(margin_raw, 0.0, 1e9)
    margin = ops.mul(margin_clamped, adv)

    loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.ones_like(adv), margin))
    return loss
